extracted.intended_audience: attorneys/applicants seeking reinstatement to practice before the USPTO and Office of Enrollment and Discipline staff
extracted.subtask_description: Decision on a petition for reinstatement to practice before the United States Patent and Trademark Office under the Office of Enrollment and Discipline procedures, addressing compliance with the governing regulation and the Director's discretionary determination. The page records receipt and supplementation dates and the Director's grant of reinstatement.

rubrics_metrics.name: Compliance with 37 CFR § 11.58
rubrics_metrics.description: Mr. Cohen complied with all provisions of 37 CFR § 11.58 on or before December 22, 2014.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Compliance with the provisions of 37 CFR § 11.58 is a prerequisite considered by the Office when deciding petitions for reinstatement; the decision records the date by which compliance was achieved. (The page cites compliance but does not reproduce the regulation's specific requirements.)

rubrics_metrics.name: Director's determination of appropriateness
rubrics_metrics.description: After careful review of the Petition, the Director of the Office of Enrollment and Discipline has determined that reinstatement of Mr. Cohen to practice before the United States Patent and Trademark Office is appropriate.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Reinstatement is a discretionary action by the Director based on review of the petition and supporting materials; the Director must find reinstatement 'appropriate' to grant the petition. The page contains no further detail on the standards applied in that review beyond this statement.

rubrics_metrics.name: Petition submission and supplementation (procedural record)
rubrics_metrics.description: Consideration has been given to the Petition for Reinstatement of Charles Ellis Cohen received on April 20, 2015 and supplemented on April 27, 2015.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: A petition should be filed and any supporting supplementation recorded; the decision notes receipt and supplement dates as part of the administrative record. The page does not specify filing deadlines or required contents of the petition beyond referencing 37 CFR § 11.58.
